column7: Reachability only, no reflection. For open() and openLazy(), two payloads that share one lexeme are tracked weakly (WeakReference + ReferenceQueue) while the catalog stays strongly reachable (Reference.reachabilityFence). Control: after 3 explicit GCs the open catalog still holds both, and warm lookups return the same instances. Then close(), and a bounded loop runs at most 40 rounds of System.gc() plus a 50 ms queue wait; it must clear and enqueue both references. A lookup after close must throw IllegalStateException. A payload the caller kept is still intact after close (the crate's escaped-ownership check). Mutant mutA (L240 removed): AssertionError check 5 in all 4 VM modes and in 50/50 repeated runs. Master: 200/200 passes (50 in each of jit, -Xint, -XX:-CompactStrings, -Xbatch -XX:-TieredCompilation), each needing 1 GC round

column7: No m3/core test is added. The contract can't be observed through the public or package-visible API, and SharedLexiconCatalog has no loader injection point: M3PrecomputePayload.parse is a static call inside the computeIfAbsent lambda. ConcurrentHashMap.computeIfAbsent never re-runs its mapping function for a key that is already present. So the loader count (1) and the identity of the returned instance are the same with or without the warm get. probe/SharedLexiconCatalogWarmLookupProbe.java (blob d67d0a1619c3) shows this. Through the public API it prints observable_same=true on master, mutA and mutB (L356-357 removed), so mutB survives. With --reflective, the crate's counting-map swap gives compute_if_absent_calls=1 on master and 101 on mutB (100 warm lookups, jit and -Xint), so only deep reflection sees the contract. Deep reflection is not available to make/m3/build.sh's tests: module jdk.m3.text exports jdk.m3.text but does not open it, and on the module path the swap throws InaccessibleObjectException unless the JVM runs with --add-opens jdk.m3.text/jdk.m3.text=ALL-UNNAMED. Covering b needs one of: a production seam (a package-private loader or cache injection in SharedLexiconCatalog, or opens in module-info), or a decision to give the test --add-opens in make/m3/build.sh. This leaf changes neither
